sentences.en: The photographer developed the film in the darkroom.
sentences.zh: 摄影师在暗室里冲洗底片。

sentences.en: We used to spend hours exploring every corner of the darkroom.
sentences.zh: 我们过去常常花好几个小时探索暗室里的每一个角落。

sentences.en: The darkroom has a special light that doesn't affect the photos being processed.
sentences.zh: 暗室里有一种特殊的灯光不会影响正在处理的照片。

senses.zh: （冲洗底片的）暗室，暗房,黑屋子
